feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 12 May 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A few outbreaks of rain at first, but this will clear by mid-morning as sunny intervals develop, but always with the risk of an odd shower. Fresh locally strong west or northwest wind and a maximum temperature of 13°C.

Sunshine and blustery showers tomorrow, some of the showers may be heavy in places and accompanied by a strong and gusty northwest wind. Top temperature 12°C but feeling colder in the wind.


##Outlook##

Cloudy start on Thursday with a few showery outbreaks of rain, the showers becoming isolated into the afternoon as sunny intervals develop. Fresh to strong north or northwest wind and a highest temperature of 12°C.
